account.title: Account in the app
account.help: The case needs a login to the app under test, such as a test user or an admin role.

third_party_account.title: Third-party account
third_party_account.help: The case goes through another service (payments, email, a social login) and needs an account there.

device.title: Physical device
device.help: The case needs a real phone, a card reader or other hardware the agent cannot reach.

environment.title: Environment
environment.help: The case needs a running environment, such as staging or a seeded database, or its address.

judgment.title: A person's judgment
judgment.help: Only a person can say whether the result is right (copy, design, a judgment call). The video shows what happened.

other.title: Something else
other.help: Anything else the agent could not get by itself.
